profile.headline: SWE Intern @ Tesla | Prev. SWE Intern @ C1, Workiva | President CSE @ ISU | CS & Math @ ISU
profile.summary:
hello, i'm alex 🫪

• incoming swe intern @ Tesla
• prev swe intern @ Workiva, C1
• fourth-year CS + Math @ ISU
• 3.90 GPA
• doing it for the love of the game (programming)

also, i enjoy doing things:
• president of the Computer Science and Software Engineering Club @ ISU (220+ members)
• ex 1/3 honors undergrad assistants helping run the first-year program
• ex undergraduate researcher in Data Storage lab
• ex peer educator for Multicultural Student Affairs @ ISU (21 mentees)
• ex Data Structures (COMS 2280) TA and CS Peer Mentor

feel free to reach out for any reason!

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Worked on a survey project regarding the past decade of storage systems publications from conferences like FAST, SOSP, NSDI, and OSDI to quantify trends, derive principles, and identify potential areas of future research

positions.title: First-Year Honors Leader
positions.description:
•Served as a mentor and peer to 12 first-year ISU honors students to ease their transition into ISU
•Worked with a co-leader to create a 32 lesson plans for the semesters curriculum
•Attend 6 leadership training sessions throughout the spring semester for leadership education

positions.title: Software Engineering Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a VR application using Unity/C# that seamlessly integrates custom USD files
• Created 20+ interactive pieces of USD models to respond to user interactions, such as grabbing and rotating
• Enabled seamless live-session experience tested for 5+ simultaneous users, allowing them to interact and collaborate
on models with less than 100ms synchroinzation latency.
• Curated and presented live oral presentation in front of 40+ audience members at a research symposium to share
the goals and progress of the project

positions.title: Peer Educator
positions.description:
Peer educator for ISU Multicultural Student Affairs (MSA)

• Guide cohort of 22 high-achieving GWCSL (full-tuition scholarship) students through their first year at ISU
• Create and lead 8 on-campus events for 200 students throughout each semester

positions.title: CS Peer Mentor
positions.description:
Peer Mentor for the ISU CS Departnent

• Advise 26 first-year computer science students to facilitate success through ISU’s CS program
• Aid students in fundamental topics like object-oriented programming and basic data structures through office hours
• Facilitate social growth by leading an interactive lecture once a week with engaging activities

honors.title: George Washington Carver Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Iowa State University · Jul 2023
